text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Zenno Rob Roy
excitedly
chattering away at Agnes
Digital.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The choice of paper, the ink, the ribbon

bookmark, the binding... Every last
detail of the
original print has been
expertly recreated, right
down to the
materials and methods used!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh, thank youuu! It means so, so
much that
you recognize all the effort
that went into it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello! We were just talking about
this book.
Isn't it magnificent?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's a reprint of an old novel, done by
Digital's
family's printshop!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And the craftsmanship is absolutely
superb! When
I spotted Digital, I
couldn't help but get carried
away
gushing about the quality.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I mean, I didn't do anything, but I'm
sure my dad
will be over the moon when
I tell him!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yep, he's a total nerd when it comes to
books.
He's been crazy locked in on the
reprint project
since the very first
planning talk.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A total... nerd? It sounds like the apple
didn't fall
far from the tree, then!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh, I-I guess. We are both super passionate about our interests.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll admit that I do take after him a lot.

text_block_list.name: Digital's Father
text_block_list.text: Yeees! I finally found the perfect paper! It's just glossy enough to feel smooth while letting a little light through when flipped. It's just matte enough to prevent annoying ink glare all while preventing bleed through from the page under!

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text:
Daaad, why are you running around the
office
shouting? What's so exciting
about paper?

text_block_list.name: Digital's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there, Digi. The thing about
paper is, it
holds bazillions of
possibilities—and all of them
are
breathtaking! ☆ Paper is where it's at!

text_block_list.name: Digital's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You should explore hobbies and
find
something that makes you extra
special happy,
Digi. Life's so much fun
when you've got an
interest to fangirl
over. ♪

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(It was a few years later that I found my
ultimate
passion. It was a normal day like
any other. I was
playing in the
breakroom at Dad's
printshop—until fate
put that show on the TV...)

text_block_list.name: Documentary
text_block_list.text:
A professional racer starts her routine
bright and
early—even on the day after
losing the G1 race
she worked so hard
for. Tears glitter in her eyes
as she
pushes herself forward, running around
the
training track.

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text: Gasp! She's... She's so... so noble!

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaah, w-what is this feeling? Why
does my
heart feel like she's squeezing it
harder with each
beat?!

text_block_list.name: Young Digital
text_block_list.text:
What's happening to me? D-DAAAAAD!

MOOOOOM!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: After my fangirl awakening, my parents bought me a whole bunch of books and merch. Next thing I knew, I was deep in the Umamusume racing fandom.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
By the time I graduated from elementary
school, I
was already a hardcore Uma
otaku.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back, it's kinda crazy how
happy they
were for me figuring out
what I love.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Like, if they hadn't thrown their full
support
behind me the way they did, I
don't think I would
be the person I am
now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So I really have to hand it to them both
for how
wonderful every day feels.
Y-Y'know what I
mean?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Of course. It's a lovely thing—the way
you're able
to wholeheartedly devote
yourself to your
interests. And I'm sure
your parents knew the
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
They're both amazing people...
encouraging their
daughter's love so
earnestly.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
They're both amazing people...
encouraging their
daughter's love so
earnestly.
choice_data_list: You really have a wonderful family.
You really have a wonderful family, don't you?
Thanks to my hobbies, I've become pretty versatile, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hwaaa?! Trainer? ...You think so too?
choice_data_list: You really have a wonderful family.

Thanks to my hobbies, I've become pretty versatile, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But... I really am super lucky. I'm glad I
have
parents that encourage me to love
what I love.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Ehehe! I won't lie though, it is
kinda
embarrassing having all the
attention on little old
Digitan!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I agree. Digital's so knowledgeable
about
Umamusume racing. You have
such a strong grasp
of history and
tactics.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, you also make the
time to
pursue art and creative writing.
You've made all
kinds of fanworks,
right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
HWACK?! H-how do you—who told you
that?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uh, um, s-so uh... You've gotta
understand,
people have been writing
fanfics since time
immemorial! A lot of
famous, historic literature
was made by
fans of earlier works! I-it's
completely
normal!!!!!
